name: Brunyola i Sant Martí Sapresa (Spain)
description: Red field with the white cross fleury voided of the arms in the upper hoist and two yellow flames at the fly.
history: The flag was approved on 2 March 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3347 of 14 March 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with the white cross fleury voided of the arms, 5/18 of the length high and wide, with arms 1/18 of the height thick.

features.role: cross fleury voided of the arms, 5/18 of the length
two flames at the upper and lower fly
